Preserve every branch, detached stroke, counter, gap, contact and bar length relationship. NO labels, text, codepoints, frames, grids, shadows, watermark, background, multiple glyphs.  For U+3D42F follow coherent whole THX, not QJZ lower variant. LEFT component tall upper curved vertical crossing sloped horizontal, short right upright with free lower end, long main leg bending down LEFT then side branch curves RIGHT and descends as separate long straight-ish leg. RIGHT top rounded rectangle with middle horizontal divider TWO stacked counters and top knob. Central stem from boxbottom extends long to baseline, two stacked downward-opening paired chevrons attach at distinct heights; nearbottom broad horizontal crosses stem; stem extends below. Preserve left/right separation, no leftcup.
